spec.name: Bloc Habitat 9000
spec.description: A raw-concrete brutalist housing block: a pilotis podium and plaza, a repetitive window-grid slab tower, a cantilevered upper volume, an exposed service core and a cluttered concrete rooftop.
spec.layout: The model faces +Z (the entrance side). At the bottom, a full-width podium (y 0–5) stands on a forest of heavy square pilotis columns around a recessed glass lobby and a raised concrete plaza with low benches, planters and wide steps touching the floor. Above it rises the main housing slab (y 5–16, 10 m wide, 8 m deep) carrying a strict grid of deep-set windows and projecting balcony bands on its front face. Perched on the slab is the cantilevered upper volume (y 16–21), shifted left and pushed forward over the plaza with a deep overhanging soffit and a ribbon of windows. A separate service core tower (right side, x 5–7.2, full height) is a blank concrete shaft with a vertical slot of dark windows, a rust-stained face and a red steel door at ground level, running from floor to above the roofline. On top (y 21–23) sits the roofscape: a plant room, a cylindrical water tank on stub legs, ventilation stacks, a low parapet and a thin antenna. The brutalist style shows everywhere as board-formed flat concrete in two grey tones with darker weathered stains under sills and soffits, deep shadowed recesses, dark glass punched into mass, one rust-red and one signal-red accent, and small parts (window frames, drainpipes, vents, signage) seated on the big plain volumes.

parts.builds: Ground floor and plaza: a raised concrete plaza slab (pavingGrey, 0.45 m thick with a rawConcrete nosing) filling the footprint except a sunken entrance strip, reached by three broad stepped tiers at the front (+Z); a regular forest of chunky square pilotis columns (rawConcrete, ~0.6 m square, chamfered tops) supporting a deep podium deck at y 5 whose underside soffit is soffitShadow with darker weatherStain streaks; between the columns a recessed glass lobby wall of tall dark panels (glassDark with glassPale reflection panels and frameMetal mullions), a signalRed entrance door with an inkBlack number plate and a small rustAccent canopy over it; low rawConcrete benches and two planter boxes with planterGreen shrub masses on the plaza; a concrete bollard row along the plaza edge. Everything at ground level touches y = 0.
parts.attaches: Stands on the floor (floor: true). Its deck top is the podiumTop mount at y = 5, where the tower, the cantilevered volume's soffit edge and the core all land.

parts.builds: The main housing slab: a single rawConcrete mass from podiumTop to towerTop (y 5–16), 10 m wide and 8 m deep, built as a box with slab-like proportions. The front (+Z) face carries the signature brutalist window grid: five vertical window columns x six floors of deep-set recesses (glassDark panes in frameMetal surrounds, each recess cut 0.25 m into the face with a soffitShadow inner reveal), separated by wide rawConcrete piers; every second floor a full-width projecting balcony band (rawConcrete slab with concreteDark front fascia and simple frameMetal railings) cantilevering off the face; a continuous weatherStain drip streak under each balcony; small square stair windows on the left pier; a concreteCream horizontal string course at mid-height. The back and sides are quieter: sparse punched windows, two rustAccent drainpipes running the full height on the side faces, and a shadowed vertical expansion joint. Top face is the towerTop mount.
parts.attaches: Sits on the podium deck at the podiumTop mount; its top at y = 16 is the towerTop mount under the cantilevered volume; its right face meets the service core shaft.

parts.builds: The cantilevered crowning volume: a 5 m tall, 9 m wide block shifted left (x −6 to 3) and pushed forward (z −4 to 4.5) so it overhangs both the slab edge and the plaza. Deep ribbon windows wrap its front and left faces (continuous glassDark bands with frameMetal mullions and glassPale upper panels), divided by chunky rawConcrete fins every 1.5 m that emphasize the cantilever; its underside is a deep soffitShadow fascia with three rustAccent downpipes at the overhang edge; the front face carries one wide shadowed loggia notch with a frameMetal railing; the right side is a blank concreteCream party wall with a single inkBlack painted block number '9' as a decal-sized inset. Corners are sharp and unrelieved raw concrete.
parts.attaches: Rests on the slab at the towerTop mount, overhanging its left-front corner down toward the podium; its right edge is carried against the service core (mount coreTop region); its roof at y = 21 is the roofDeck mount.

parts.builds: The freestanding service and stair core: a narrow blank concrete shaft (x 5–7.2, z −3 to 0) rising unbroken from the ground to y 21.5 so it pokes above the roofline. Its front face carries one full-height vertical slot of dark glassDark windows with frameMetal mullions; its left face is raw concrete with broad weatherStain rain streaking and a rustAccent panel band at mid-height; at ground level a signalRed steel door with a small rawConcrete hood, an inkBlack floor-number column of small plates beside it, and a ventSteel louvre grille near the top; a thin frameMetal ladder bracket runs up the back face. Cap at y 21.5 is a flat concreteDark slab lid.
parts.attaches: Stands on the floor beside the podium (floor: true), its inner left face tight against the tower's right face from y 5 up; its top region (mount coreTop) meets the cantilevered volume's right edge.

parts.builds: The cluttered concrete rooftop on the roofDeck mount (y 21): a low rawConcrete parapet wall around the upper volume with a weatherStain cap; a plant room box (rawConcrete with a concreteDark door and ventSteel louvres); a cylindrical waterTank tank on four short stub legs beside it, with a frameMetal access ladder and a small rustAccent pipe dropping into the roof; two ventSteel ventilation stacks of different heights with dark caps; a thin inkBlack antenna mast on the core's lid; a few gravel patches (pavingGrey) and one planterGreen moss patch where the concrete has weathered. Kept simpler than the tower: bold silhouettes, few colours.
parts.attaches: Sits on the upper volume's roof at the roofDeck mount and on the service core's lid (coreTop); nothing extends above y = 23.
